claim: The larvae of fruit flies produce pheromones.
source: The larvae of fruit flies produce pheromones to control whether they are attracted to others of the same species or whether they avoid members of a different species.
evidence: This is stated in the abstract as a factual assertion about fruit fly larvae behavior.

claim: Fruit fly larvae pheromones control whether they are attracted to others of the same species.
source: The larvae of fruit flies produce pheromones to control whether they are attracted to others of the same species or whether they avoid members of a different species.
evidence: This is stated in the abstract as a factual assertion about the function of pheromones in controlling attraction to conspecifics.

claim: Fruit fly larvae pheromones control whether they avoid members of a different species.
source: The larvae of fruit flies produce pheromones to control whether they are attracted to others of the same species or whether they avoid members of a different species.
evidence: This is stated in the abstract as a factual assertion about the function of pheromones in controlling avoidance of heterospecifics.
